summary: Add inactive generation-local cgroup driver and B6 command construction (unit 7d)

rules.detail: Admission is not wired. Explicit launch capabilities have no scheduler, runtime activation or configuration defaults.

compatibility.detail: J is mkdir keeper/job-hash-generation, with atomic collision refusal. Unit-12 apply/readback is reused; the gated holder is attached only to an owner-writable J with empty subtree_control and no populated children or extra PIDs. B6 argv is gate-slot --class heavy --no-scope --job ID --outcome-file PATH -- LAUNCHER, covered by a command-construction test. Abort kills the gated child and J, waits populated=0, then removes J; it never stops the shared keeper.

downtime.detail: No live behavior or deployment changes.

manual.detail: No activation. Keeper and job cgroup roots are explicit capabilities; caps and heavy slice come from configuration.

recovery.detail: No generation replacement or restart recovery. Unit 8 finds J by its stable generation-specific name.
